suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2026-42154 is a denial of service in the Prometheus SERVER's remote-read endpoint (crafted snappy payload). micrometer-registry-prometheus is only the client-side exporter and has no remote-read endpoint. Reviewed 2026-10-24.

False positive: CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection in Eclipse Angus Mail / Jakarta Mail (the SMTP sender). angus-activation is the separate MIME-type activation library, and no service here sends e-mail. Reviewed 2026-10-24.

False positive: CVE-2025-15104 is a server-side request forgery in the Nu Html Checker (validator.nu, an HTML validation service). The scanner matched it only on the word "validator". hibernate-validator is the Jakarta Bean Validation implementation and has no relation to it. Reviewed 2026-10-24.

Not applicable: CVE-2026-41115 (CVSS 4.3, below the build threshold) concerns how the Kafka BROKER authorizes the CONSUMER_GROUP_DESCRIBE API (DESCRIBE instead of READ on the group), which matters only where group ACLs are configured. kafka-clients is the client library, and this project's broker runs without an authorizer or ACLs (see docker-compose.yml). Reviewed 2026-10-24.
